request_type: Event: J70 Corinthian World Championship Race Number: 01
procedural_matters: The technical committee was represented by Thomas Loesch.
MON 707 was represented by Antoine Arnoult.
Claire Tetard (crew member of MON 707) attended the hearing as an observer.
The hearing was scheduled for 16:45. MON 707 requested more time to prepare and the hearing started when she was ready at 17:06.
facts: MON 707 was called on VHF for post-race inspection but did not show up for the post-race inspection at the designated area.
The technical committee did not attempt to contact MON 707 and did not post a notice of his intention to protest on the official notice board.
conclusions: The technical committee failed to inform MON 707 of the protest at the first reasonable opportunity as required by RRS 60.2(b)(3). Therefore the protest is invalid under RRS 60.4(a)(1).
